key.railways_unlimited.snap_menu: Track angle step (goggles + track in hand)
key.railways_unlimited.straight_track: Hold for straight track while connecting
key.railways_unlimited.keep_height: Keep the height while placing track
key.railways_unlimited.keep_grade: Keep the grade while placing track
railways_unlimited.screen.title: Track Settings
railways_unlimited.screen.max_length_too: How many blocks one track placement may reach before it is "Too far away". Longer segments allow longer, smoother turns. Create's default is 32.
railways_unlimited.screen.current: Straight track snaps to multiples of %s°
railways_unlimited.screen.step_tooltip: Straight track runs at multiples of %s°
railways_unlimited.screen.clear_ghosts_t: While on, removes "ghosts" within 32 blocks around you: track graph points with no track left (purple pillars). Track itself is not touched.
railways_unlimited.screen.gauge_preview_: The placement preview shows the gauge of the track you hold: Steam 'n' Rails' wide and narrow gauge, and a monorail as one line in the middle. Off: always standard gauge.
railways_unlimited.screen.show_joints_to: Debug view: highlights the joints (anchors) of angled track around you in orange. Joints left without any track are red. Purple pillars are "ghosts": track graph points without track, which would block a new joint.
railways_unlimited.overlay.title: Track placement
railways_unlimited.message.need_goggles: Wear Engineer's Goggles to change the track angle step
railways_unlimited.message.click_closer_: Click closer to the end of the angled track
railways_unlimited.track.slope_endpoint: Cannot connect angled track to a slope block
railways_unlimited.track.anchor_blocked: A joint of this track would be blocked
railways_unlimited.track.not_a_line: Can only join the middle of a straight angled track
railways_unlimited.track.line_too_short: The turn does not fit on this track
railways_unlimited.configuration.title: Create: Railways Unlimited
railways_unlimited.configuration.snapSte: Straight track snaps to multiples of this angle. 45° is Create's default.
railways_unlimited.configuration.showOve: Show the placement angle next to the crosshair while wearing Engineer's Goggles and holding track.
